title: SafeSpit SimulationResult
description: Output document of the deterministic SafeSpit simulation. Given a Scenario, both the Dart and TypeScript implementations produce a SimulationResult that is bit-identical (within floating-point tolerance) — this is enforced by shared-spec/test-vectors.json.

scenarioSeed.description: Echoes the input scenario seed. Used for result tracking and replay.

targetPitchDeg.description: Computed optimal departure pitch per the proven base formula + vehicle modifier. Always within [45, 85] because of the clamp.

deltaDeg.description: Absolute difference between actual pitch (input) and target pitch. deltaDeg <= 5.0 is the lock tolerance.

isClearToEject.description: True iff deltaDeg <= 5.0. The lock is held for as long as this is true; audio/haptic cue fires on the edge transition only (D-13).

lockQuality.description: Smoothed quality of the lock window: 1.0 = perfectly centered, 0.0 = far outside the 5-degree window. Used for scoring nuance (GAME_SPEC.md).

trajectory.description: Polyline of the simulated projectile path in meters, NOT pixels. At least 2 points; length is implementation-defined but MUST be deterministic for a given Scenario.

x.description: Lateral offset from the target center, in meters.

y.description: Lateral offset from the target center, in meters.

deviationM.description: Euclidean distance between the impact position and the target center, in meters. Wind affects this; lock pitch does not (D-5).

score.description: Final score. Deterministic function of the simulation inputs and constants defined in the simulation implementation. Constants are tuned during playtesting; final values recorded in update.ai/DECISIONS.md (D-11).

precision.description: How close the player held the target angle.

impact.description: How close the impact was to the target center.

timing.description: How fast the lock was acquired (after a small grace period).

stability.description: How steady the player held the angle during the lock window.
